name: Social Auth
description: Allows user authentication with different services.
project_description:
This project is part of the Drupal Social Initiative and is based on the Social API . 

 

 Social Auth is part of the Social API . It provides a common interface for creating modules related to user authentication using accounts from external providers. Social Auth is not only about logging users in; you can use its API to make calls to a provider and get data or do any kind of cool things with it (aka HTTP requests). Don't believe us? Take a look at this example.
